title: Majestic Genius Draw
reviewNotes: Four branches, 27 exact positions from the complete four-piece drawing root. Kc8/...Kc6/Kb8/...Kb5/Kb7 buys time for Kc6; an explicitly independent final pawn race reaches two kings. Immediate king approach and premature pawn push lose. In the latter comparison, ...h5 preserves Black’s win while immediate ...Kxa7 returns a draw. Practice objective is draw.
